what_it_measures: Information gain: how much the predicted probability of the possession progressing changes once the model can see HOW the player moved, versus seeing only where the move started and ended. It is a DIFFERENCE between two informed estimates, not a probability of any event.
why_target_sensitive: Because the metric is the share of the outcome explained by the manner of movement rather than its geography, changing the target changes what counts as position-explained vs run-explained. The instability is inherent to an information-gain quantity, not an implementation fault.
